MATCH p = shortestPath((a)-[:line_to*]->(b))
WITH nodes(p) AS path_nodes
UNWIND range(0, size(path_nodes) - 1) AS position
WITH path_nodes[position] AS item, position
RETURN item.tag AS tag,
       item.dexpi_class AS type,
       item.datasheet IS NOT NULL AS has_datasheet
ORDER BY position
